title: Immunocytochemistry with mDANs
author: Ellen Hertz
materials: On day 35; fix mDANs in Paraformaldehyde solution 4% in PBS Santa Cruz Biotechnology Catalog #sc-281692 for 00:30:00 at Room temperature

Dilute primary antibodies in blocking buffer Sheep Tyrosine Hydroxylase Pel-Freez Catalog #P60101-150 1:400 RFP Antibody Pre-adsorbed ROCKLAND antibodes & assays Catalog # 600-401-379 1:500 HNF-3β/FoxA2 antibody Neuromics Catalog #GT15186 1:500 Mouse anti-Human GCase antibody (Clone 1/23) Michael J Fox Foundation (MJFF) Research Tools Catalog 1:1000 LAMP1 (D2D11) XP® Rabbit mAb (PE Conjugate) Cell Signaling Technology Catalog #85995 1:500 GFP tag Polyclonal antibody Proteintech Catalog #50430-2-AP 1:1000 Mitofusin-1 (D6E2S) Rabbit mAb Cell Signaling Technology Catalog #14739 1:100 StrepMAB-Classic IBA Lifesciences Catalog #2-1507-001 1:100
Dilute secondary antibodies from Jackson ImmunoResearches matching primary antibodies in blocking buffer and incubate 1 hour at Room temperature
Dissociate Day 25 mDANs with Accutase for 00:15:00
Incubate with primary antibodies at 4 °C Overnight

steps.title: Coat chambers with Geltrex
steps.instruction: Add Geltrex (Thermo Fisher Cat #A1413302) to each well of Ibidi 8‑well imaging chambers (Cat #80807-90), incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Prepare cell suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend dissociated mDANs in Neurobasal medium supplemented with B27 without vitamin A and CEPT.

steps.title: Seed mDANs onto coated chambers
steps.instruction: Plate the cell suspension into the Geltrex‑coated imaging chambers at a density of 50–100 × 10³ cells per cm².

steps.title: Wash cells with DPBS
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL DPBS to each well, rock gently for 5 minutes, then discard. Repeat for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Block cells
steps.instruction: Add blocking solution (1 % BSA, 0.1 % saponin in PBS) to each well and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS (incl. NucBlue)
steps.instruction: Perform three washes with 200 µL PBS per well, rocking gently for 5 minutes each. During the second wash, add NucBlue™ Fixed Cell ReadyProbes reagent (Thermo Fisher Cat #R37606).

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: 200 µL PBS, 5 min, gentle rocking.
Wash 2: 200 µL PBS + NucBlue (Cat #R37606), 5 min, gentle rocking.
Wash 3: 200 µL PBS, 5 min, gentle rocking.

steps.title: Image cells in DPBS
steps.instruction: Replace the final wash solution with DPBS and acquire images of the cells.
